Privacy

Your information deserves care.

Last updated

October 10, 2026. This policy covers the preview website and must be reviewed before payments or form delivery are connected.

Messages you write

The contact and involvement forms do not send anything to our servers or store what you type. When you press send, the website opens WhatsApp or your phone’s text messages with your words filled in. Nothing is sent until you send it there. WhatsApp and your mobile carrier handle that message under their own privacy policies.

Giving

Online payments are not connected. The giving preview does not collect card details or process a charge.

Cookies and analytics

This website sets no analytics or marketing cookies. Our hosting provider may process technical request data, such as IP addresses, needed to serve the website. Links to other services, such as 988 or Arizona 211, have their own privacy policies.

Questions

Call +1 (402) 870-8800 to ask the team about privacy.
